tools.name: get_class_diagram
tools.description: Generates a Mermaid class diagram for the types defined in a specific C# file or directory, with options to discover inheritance and related types in the workspace.

path.description: Absolute path to the .cs file or directory to analyze.

maxDepth.description: How many levels of relationships to follow (default: 1).

includeInheritance.description: Whether to search the workspace for base classes and interfaces.

includeDependencies.description: Whether to search for and include other classes used as properties or fields.

includeProperties.description: Whether to display properties and fields in the class diagram (default: true).

includeFunctions.description: Whether to display functions/methods in the class diagram (default: true).

showTitle.description: Whether to include the title in the diagram (default: true).

tools.name: get_erd
tools.description: Generates a Mermaid Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD) from an Entity Framework Core DbContext or ModelSnapshot file, including entities, properties, relationships, constraints, and inherited properties from base classes.

path.description: Absolute path to a .cs file containing a DbContext or ModelSnapshot.

contextName.description: Specific DbContext or ModelSnapshot class name to use if multiple are present.

showTitle.description: Whether to include the title in the diagram (default: true).

ownedMode.description: How EF Core owned types are shown: 'mirror' (default) inlines table-split owned types onto the owner as EF names them; 'classic' gives every owned type its own entity

tools.name: get_project_graph
tools.description: Analyzes a .NET solution or project file and returns the dependency graph as a Mermaid diagram.

path.description: Absolute path to the project or solution file.

showTitle.description: Whether to include the title in the diagram (default: true).

includePackages.description: Whether to include NuGet package dependencies in the graph (default: false).

tools.name: get_project_stats
tools.description: Analyses a .NET solution or project file and returns key architectural metrics: project count, type breakdown, dependency depth statistics, most-referenced (hotspot) projects, and cycle detection.

path.description: Absolute path to a .NET solution (.sln/.slnx) or project (.csproj) file.

topN.description: Number of top most-referenced projects to include. Defaults to 5.

prompts.name: architecture_review
prompts.description: Guides an LLM through a comprehensive architecture review of a .NET solution, including dependency visualization and project metrics.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Absolute (or root-relative) path to the solution file (.sln, .slnx) or project file (.csproj)

prompts.name: class_structure_review
prompts.description: Guides an LLM through reviewing C# class hierarchies, inheritance patterns, and overall design structure.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Absolute path to a .cs file or directory to analyze

prompts.name: database_schema_review
prompts.description: Guides an LLM through reviewing an Entity Framework Core database schema for design quality, relationships, and potential issues.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Absolute path to a .cs file containing a DbContext or ModelSnapshot

arguments.name: contextName
arguments.description: Specific DbContext or ModelSnapshot class name to use if multiple exist in the file

prompts.name: dependency_analysis
prompts.description: Guides an LLM to analyze dependency depth, identify hotspot projects, and detect potential circular dependencies in a .NET solution.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Absolute path to the solution or project file

arguments.name: topN
arguments.description: Number of top hotspot projects to highlight
